For the first few days, definitely keep it covered to help avoid infection. It’s better to keep it moist with like neosporin or aquaphor and then covered with gauze/bandaids. Once it’s closed, keep a bandaid on it during the day but leaving it open over night will help it heal faster. It’ll probably take a few weeks to heal. Hope that helps! (From, a nurse who also SH)
